messages:
Tara Singh: FYI HearthCart (mid-market, renewal in 7d) pinged CSM: sudden cost spike + feature rollout stalled. They mentioned spikes in hour-long inference batches. Need a compact save play we can run before renewal.
Diego Marquez: Any telemetry? is it heavy context length or accidental retry loops?
Priya Nair: Early look: a new export job they started last week is sending repeated long prompts with attachments. Token consumption up ~4x. Also a few thousand duplicate requests from a misconfigured webhook.
incident-bot: Alert: HearthCart webhook error loop detected; duplicate rate 12k/hr. TraceID: hc-8943. See /ops/alerts/hc-8943
Ben Holt: Ok we should split this into 3 tracks: immediate rate-limits & webhook fix, short-term cost relief offer, and post-trial enablement to avoid regression.
Tara Singh: Agreed. Customer is very price-sensitive; if we don't present a tight path they'll likely downgrade. Draft quick offer: 2-week cost credit + engineering help to fix webhook + ops checklist. Thoughts?
Diego Marquez: Two technical fixes we can do instantly: 1) apply a temporary per-route rate limit (throttle at 500r/s) 2) put their heavy export route on a low-priority tier to avoid hitting shared SLOs. Both reversible.
Priya Nair: Also recommend a one-click token guard in their dashboard (limit max tokens per request) and a short cron job to dedupe webhook retries. I can ship a patched snippet:
```
# dedupe pseudo
if seen_event(event_id): return 409
process()
```
Ben Holt: Commercial: propose 15% credit for 2 weeks plus a free technical health check (2 hours) and 1 enablement session. If they sign a 3-month committed plan within 30d, convert credits to prepaid value. If they insist on downgrade, offer a staged downgrade matrix: preserve their storefront route at standard latency, move analytics/export to best-effort.
Cassandra Lee: I'll prepare the downgrade matrix doc (simple table) and a short customer-facing save email. Will include bullet points: what we fix now, what they need to change, timeline, outcomes.
Tara Singh: Need owners and deadlines. I'll run the customer call. Diego you'll handle the immediate throttles. Priya ship the webhook fix. Cassandra draft email and downgrade matrix. Ben draft commercial terms. Target: call in 24h, assets in 12h.
Diego Marquez: Throttles applied to export route (temporary) and monitoring alerting set to notify this channel. Will revert after troubleshooting.
Priya Nair: Webhook dedupe snippet deployed to staging, pushing to prod after call approval. Also instrumented a histogram of request sizes. Early numbers show 70% of tokens from export route.
Ben Holt: Commercial terms: 15% credit, 2-week trial credit, one-time health check; optional 3-month commit with 10% ongoing discount. I'll upload terms to the shared proposal: https://drive.redwood/hc-save-offer-1945
Cassandra Lee: Email draft:
```
Hi HearthCart team,
Thanks for flagging. Short summary: we've temporarily limited the export route to reduce duplicate processing and applied a token guard to prevent runaway jobs. Proposed immediate next steps: (1) 30-min triage call tomorrow, (2) prod webhook fix and token guard, (3) 2-week cost credit while we validate. If you'd like to reduce costs permanently, we can propose a staged downgrade that protects storefront latency.
Best, Tara + Redwood CS
```
Tara Singh: Good. If the customer accepts the 2-week credit and fixes, we then run the enablement session on token budgeting and scheduled exports. If they still want to leave, follow the downgrade matrix but keep their customer-facing routes on standard SLAs.
Diego Marquez: Logs after throttles: duplicate requests dropped by 95%, token burn down following. I'll keep sampling.
Priya Nair: Prod webhook fix live after 11:15 PT deploy (no rollback required). I'll post post-deploy metrics in 1h.
Cassandra Lee: Matrix and email uploaded. Also added a one-page checklist for the call. Link: https://drive.redwood/hc-save-assets-1945
Ben Holt: Sales note: keep conversation focused on operational quick wins and short-term credits; avoid blanket discounts. If they push on price, lead with commit options instead of permanent rate cuts.
Tara Singh: Call scheduled for 10am PT tomorrow. Action items recap:
- Diego: maintain throttles + monitor (owner)
- Priya: confirm webhook fix metrics + token histogram (owner)
- Ben: finalize offer sheet (owner)
- Cassandra: customer email + downgrade matrix (owner)
I'll update this thread after the call. Escalate to @Head_CS if no decision within 48h. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
